title: Org-Chart Budget Rollup
description:
Each employee has an own `budget`. Using a recursive CTE, compute **rolled-up budget = own budget + all descendants' budgets** for every person in the org chart.

**Table: org** — `emp_id`, `name`, `manager_id`, `budget`

Output columns: `emp_id`, `name`, `rolled_up_budget`. Order by `emp_id`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE org (emp_id INT, name VARCHAR, manager_id INT, budget INT); INSERT INTO org VALUES (1,'CEO',NULL,100),(2,'VP Eng',1,50),(3,'VP Sales',1,40),(4,'Eng Lead',2,20),(5,'Engineer',4,10),(6,'Sales Rep',3,15);
solution_sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT emp_id AS root_id, emp_id, budget FROM org UNION ALL SELECT t.root_id, o.emp_id, o.budget FROM tree t JOIN org o ON o.manager_id = t.emp_id) SELECT o.emp_id, o.name, SUM(t.budget) AS rolled_up_budget FROM org o JOIN tree t ON t.root_id = o.emp_id GROUP BY o.emp_id, o.name ORDER BY o.emp_id

test_cases.description: Engineer 10, Eng Lead 30, VP Eng 80, Sales Rep 15, VP Sales 55, CEO 235

hints: Anchor: every employee as a root pointing at themselves.
Recursive step: walk to children via manager_id, keeping the original root_id, then SUM(budget) per root.
explanation: Engineer=10. Eng Lead=20+10=30. VP Eng=50+30=80. Sales Rep=15. VP Sales=40+15=55. CEO=100+80+55=235. The recursive expansion produces one row per (ancestor, descendant) pair including self.
